scope: Broaden the open-source parser and semantic-evidence survey with Fusion ASM BinaryFile8 and Inventor tooling; refine the existing composed evidence checkpoint only.

method.kind: Current primary repository README, validation guide, license, and existing local plan review

routes.name: ezf3d Fusion reader
routes.observed: The repository describes an alpha, clean-room MIT reader for Fusion .f3d/.f3z files and identifies embedded .smb entries as ASM BinaryFile8. It reports B-rep traversal and analytic geometry checks against edge/vertex and cached-display-mesh redundancies across four Fusion designs.
routes.planUse: Optional distinct parser candidate only if an exact target payload/profile is shown to be accepted by a pinned ezf3d revision. At the existing composed checkpoint, report payload profile applicability, parser structure, and independently expected semantics as separate evidence fields.
doesNotEstablish: DWG or DXF parsing, ACIS entity-carrier extraction, or DWG AcDs owner/key/index association
compatibility between Fusion ASM BinaryFile8 and any DXF SAT/SAB or DWG ACDSDATA payload
independent semantic truth from another producer, because the reviewed examples and cached display meshes share Fusion producer lineage
release maturity or support claims from alpha status, self-tests, a cache comparison, or parser success

routes.name: inventor-kit and cq-acis
routes.observed: inventor-kit documents an IPT/CFB/RSe to saved SAB/ASM to acis-core/AcisModel to CadQuery pipeline, and declares cq-acis plus acis-core/bridge dependencies. Its current README identifies PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 for new material. Its validation guide says frozen geometry metrics originate from the same converter, analytic cylinder/box checks are narrow, ezdxf checks SAB record boundaries only, STEP/XDE checks hierarchy and metrics but not native Inventor state, and Apprentice/Inventor comparisons require actual provider captures.
routes.planUse: Do not count as a distinct ACIS decoder or independent kernel vote from cq-acis/CadQuery/OCCT; do not add as a dependency without a separate license decision. Retain only as an optional Inventor container/profile reference and as a parser-lineage/validation-independence caution.
doesNotEstablish: a separate DWG/DXF/AcDs parser or independent ACIS semantic oracle
current-state Inventor equivalence from saved geometry or same-converter baselines
a license suitable for adoption in libdxfrw
